Distribution and habitat: — Aspalathus outrampsii grows in a Fynbos / Renosterveld transitional zone in a flat sandy wide riverbed. It occurs in vegetation described by Rebelo et al. (2006) as Cango Conglomerate Fynbos (FFt 1), South Swartberg Sandstone Fynbos (FFs 24) and North Rooiberg Sandstone Fynbos (FFs 21). Locally common in dense stands between (440) 1000 – 1400 m altitude. Flowering takes place between October and November.
